in_marathi.name: Devahansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devahansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devahansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Deva’ (god) and ‘Hansh’ (treasure). The name signifies a god-given treasure or a divine blessing. In Hindu mythology, gods are believed to bestow their blessings upon their devotees, and the name Devahansh symbolizes this divine grace.
